Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.

properties.text:
transition_step(低分辨率下跑的采样步数）
1.默认设置比总步数少一步，比如总步数8步，这边设置7，高分辨率就只要跑2步。
2.文戏可以适当减少步数，武戏建议增加步数。

lowres_scale(低分辨率跑的具体分辨率）
1.比如工作流分辨率设置为2M，该参数设置为0.3，则2*0.3=0.6。即低分辨率跑的就是1M的像素，
2.建议低分辨率像素需要大于等于0.4M（480P）

其他保持默认即可

本工作流为二合一生工作流。如果不清楚请观看教学视频：https://space.bilibili.com/153038944?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0。

2.打开视频生成，图像1，上传生成的图片，输入视频提示词，生成视频。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic + Midjourney aesthetic, Chinese celestial palace above a sea of clouds, 10 seconds, 21:9 ultra-widescreen. Preserve the approved first-frame composition, subject identity, materials, colors and spatial relationships in <Picture 1>: the colossal celestial palace complex occupies most of the frame with its upper structures extending beyond the top edge; ultra-wide-angle distant view from a low ground-level camera looking steeply upward; near foreground clouds and cliff edges frame the lower corners; a tiny distant boat and tiny figures establish immense scale; low horizon line; diagonal rim light on roof ridges and tower silhouettes. Starting state: the palace stands firm and fully legible within the cloud sea, with glazed tiles, vermilion columns, white marble balustrades and wooden dougong brackets clearly visible. Gradual motion onset: the cloud sea begins flowing from left to right with clearly visible amplitude, the banner and wind chimes at the eaves begin swinging more noticeably, and the tiny distant boat starts drifting slowly. Continuous development: clouds continue their pronounced left-to-right flow, foreground cloud vapor shifts with clear parallax, banners and chimes maintain visible swaying, the distant boat keeps moving, while the palace architecture remains stable without deformation or drift. Camera movement: low ground-level slow push-in toward the palace base, keeping the steep upward angle, with medium amplitude, moving approximately 8%–12% of the frame width over the 10-second duration. Ending state: the palace still dominates the sky, the cloud sea continues its pronounced flow, the foreground parallax is fully established, and the composition remains intact without pulling back or shrinking the palace. Coherent environmental motion and restrained light changes throughout: volumetric light shifts slowly, cloud-sea translucency and rim light remain present, and shadow areas retain detail in wood and stone. Maintain the approved shot continuity and focus behavior.

overall_soundscape: High-altitude wind flows continuously across the scene, with audible cloud-sea movement and a distant wind chime ringing. Banners at the palace eaves flap distinctly in the wind, and the tiny distant boat produces a faint drifting sound. No dialogue. The scene remains vast and open.

non_diegetic_music: Guqin and xiao carry a spacious, solemn Chinese melody, supported by low strings and soft percussion. The tempo is slow and restrained, with a gradual build and a fading ending that matches the celestial atmosphere. The music remains distinct from the environmental sound and can be modified.
